title: StreamUpdatePacket
description: Structured packet for routing an update from a stream chat into the KeepMees repo docs

sourceStream.description: Name of the stream that produced this update (e.g. Production - Vendor Feasibility)

streamChatNumber.description: Chat number (01–15) in the 15-chat operating model

preparedBy.description: Agent or human that prepared this packet

summary.description: One-paragraph summary of what changed or was decided in this stream update

status.description: Status of the content in this packet

decisions.description: Decisions made or proposed in this update

risks.description: New risks surfaced by this update

docsToUpdate.description: Relative file paths of docs that should be updated from this packet

actionRequested.description: What action is requested from the recipient of this packet

routingTargets.description: Who should receive and act on this packet

coordinatorApprovalRequired.description: True if Coordinator must approve before any action is taken

rawSourceExcerpt.description: Optional: key raw text from the source chat that backs the decisions in this packet
